svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Weather-or-Not architecture
svg.desc: SEC EDGAR, NOAA GHCN-Daily and the company_dns SIC list are read only through Zetaris Lightning: REST tables, a parquet filestore, cached SchemaStore views and the weather_or_not_usl Unified Semantic Layer with key and coverage data-quality rules. A gateway exposes 28 named SQL templates behind an allowlist to the agent server, where a Markovian question chain planned by Nemotron 3 Nano 4B on local Ollama runs ten deterministic tools, H-MEM keeps facts with Zetaris provenance and recast conflicts, the World Model keeps the utility graph with dated edges, every number cites an evidence record with its SQL text, and the analyst reviews the answer card, overrides a recast resolution under a signed contract, and reads the why trace in the UI.
svg.text: Weather-or-Not: from public data to a cited split of a utility's revenue change
One machine: Zetaris Lightning in local Docker, the gateway and the agent server on 127.0.0.1, Nemotron in local Ollama. No cloud model calls.
on the AWS Open Data bucket
9 files per partition, every station worldwide
won.ghcn_* filtered to the 56 seed stations
degree days computed here, in Lightning SQL
PK/FK rules + custom DQ rule coverage_ok
RUN DQ at onboarding gates the verdict
Every statement is Lightning SQL over JDBC.
The agent never writes SQL; the gateway's
named templates do, and the SQL text is
bounded chunks: at most 10, carried state at most 800 tokens
planner: Nemotron chooses the next tool; one repair round
NEEDS_TOOL executor runs the ten host tools
deterministic fallback: the next open checklist item
every number cites SQL text, rows, Zetaris object, endpoint, licence,
retrieval time, latency and cache state
ask with a live timeline (SSE), the answer card with ranges and
confidence, the evidence drawer (the SQL is the citation),
